newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a Fator buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig still a Fator buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian power firm Cemig, which is majority owned by Minas Gerais state.

-- The investment bank said Minas Gerais state's plans to auction off a 33 percent block of Cemig common to a private strategic partner will push stock prices up in the short term and improve the firm's long-term results.
-- The bank quoted Minas Deputy Governor Walfrido dos Mares Guia as saying the sale rules will be published by October's end and the auction held between November 18 and December 13.
